To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we developed an integrated decision support system and image archive for histological subtyping of breast cancer, based on the WHO classification, and evaluated it in a study with six pathologists.

we developed a decision support system based on highly‐structured histological typing criteria integrated with high‐ quality microscope images, and that this system may contribute to a reproducible and prognosically relevant histological type of breast cancer.

the decision support system was useful for histological typing, and that the use of this system resulted in increased reproducibility and more uniform histological typing of invasive ductal carcinoma.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a decision support system based on highly defined histological typing criteria for breast cancer, integrated with high quality microscope images illustrating the typing criteria.
the application of a computerised expert system to histological typing of invasive ductal breast carcinoma.
developing a computer‐based decision support system to assist the histological typing of invasive ductal breast carcinoma according to the World health organisation criteria.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the decision support system/image archiving system for histological typing is a useful tool for teaching as well as for daily diagnostic breast histological pathology, because of its potential to improve reproducibility of the histological typing of invasive carcinoma of the breast.

the decision support system is an instrument that may be useful to improve reproducibility of breast cancer histological typing and may contribute to more reproducible and more relevant prognostic typing of breast cancer.
this system may be of use in the diagnostic work of breast histopathologists and that it may also be of use in teaching and research.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the integrated image database/ROIS system is useful as a decision‐support system in the histological typing of invasive ductal breast carcinoma and may contribute to a higher reproducibility of the typing.

we have shown that the use of the ROIS as an expert system in histopathology is feasible and that it can improve the reproducibility and the prognostic relevance of histological typing of invasive ductal breast cancer.
the integrated decision support system/ image archive for histological type‐ ing of breast cancer, based on the Relation Oriented Infer‐ ence System, is a useful instrument in breast histopathology.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of the decision‐making system influenced the previously assessed histologic types in about half of our cases, and the use of the system resulted in more uniform histologic typing.
the development of a decision support system is a feasible and promising way to improve the reproducibility and prognostic relevance of histological typing of invasive carcinomas of the breast.
a decision support system can be a valuable tool in histopathology.
